description.zh: 后端服务名称，可根据该名称过滤路由
description.en: The backend service name. You can use this name to filter routes.

description.zh: 根据特定的消费者授权规则ID过滤接口列表，响应中的接口列表仅包含已授权的接口。
description.en: Filters the API list by a specific consumer authorization rule ID. The response only includes authorized APIs.
The deployment status of the route.

description.zh: 根据域名ID过滤路由信息。
description.en: Filters route information by domain name ID.
Specifies whether the request is for a deployment scenario.

description.zh: 分页页码，从1开始，不填默认1.
description.en: The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页大小，有效范围[1, 100]，不填默认10。
description.en: The page size. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 响应中携带消费者授权信息。
description.en: Includes consumer authorization information in the response.

description.zh: 响应中每个路由信息携带指定消费者ID的授权规则列表。
description.en: Includes the authorization rule list of the specified consumer ID for each route in the response.

description.zh: 响应中每个路由信息携带指定的插件ID的挂载信息。
description.en: Includes the mount information of the specified plug-in ID for each route in the response.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun apig list-http-api-routes --http-api-id api-cr68g1dlhtgm31f000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --environment-id env-cpqnr6tlhtgubc000 --deploy-statuses NotDeployed --name itemcenter-gateway --name-like item --path-like /v1 --gateway-id gw-cpv4sqdl0000 --with-consumer-info-by-id cs-xxx --consumer-authorization-rule-id cas-xxx --with-auth-policy-info true --with-plugin-attachment-by-plugin-id pl-xxx --domain-id d-xxx --for-deploy true --backend-service-name test-svc --region cn-hangzhou
